environment.baselineFailure: new public API must be exported

prompt: Add public applyPatchSet(files, patchSet, options?) and PatchSetError to jsdiff. files is a Map of relative POSIX paths to text; patchSet is unified diff text or the array returned by parsePatch. Return a new Map after applying every patch in order. Never mutate the input Map, options, or parsed patch objects, including on failure. Support updates, additions (/dev/null old name), deletions (/dev/null new name), renames (different old/new paths), empty files, and sequential changes to a file created or renamed earlier in the same set. A rename target or added path that already exists must fail; a required old path that is absent must fail. A deletion must patch its old content to the empty string; otherwise fail. Pass existing applyPatch options such as fuzzFactor and compareLine through to maintained patch application. If applyPatch returns false, fail the entire transaction. Implement against the maintained parsePatch/applyPatch machinery, not a second diff parser or patch engine. options.strip defaults to 0 and must be a nonnegative integer; remove that many leading slash-separated path components before validation. After stripping, reject empty paths, absolute paths, backslashes, drive prefixes, NUL, and any . or .. component; /dev/null is only the creation/deletion sentinel. Reject a patch with both names /dev/null. Throw PatchSetError with code, patchIndex (zero-based index of the failing patch, -1 for whole-input/option errors), and path when available. Codes: INVALID_PATH for invalid normalized names or strip, MISSING_FILE for absent old files, TARGET_EXISTS for collisions, PATCH_FAILED for a hunk mismatch, INVALID_PATCH for malformed patch text or invalid deletion/both-null patches. No filesystem I/O belongs in this API. Empty patch text/array returns an equal but independent Map. Preserve the exact successful applyPatch result including CRLF and no-final-newline handling. Publish through source, CJS and ESM/browser bundles; retain existing APIs and supported syntax targets. Add permanent tests spanning transactional failure after earlier success, path validation, mixed create/update/rename/delete, parsed input reuse, empty files and newline/fuzz options. Document the API and errors, add a runnable multi-file example, run the original suite and build/lint checks, and report actual validation. Make routine choices autonomously.
